notify.blind_alert: {outcome} selects one of three whole sentences; {time} is a clock time (when Climate Advisor will stop the fan).
notify.blind_recovered: {when} and {tail} select phrases; keep the sentence order. 'short outage' means under 5 minutes.
notify.control_mode_not_obeyed: {requested} and {live} are raw thermostat state codes (heat, cool, off ...): leave them unchanged. {live} already carries its quotes.
notify.control_mode_not_obeyed_for: Same as control_mode_not_obeyed; 'min' is the abbreviation for minutes.
notify.control_output_stall: Status-card diagnostic. {diag} is a nested message (thermostat mode and action codes).
notify.entity_health_multi: {names} is a locale-joined list; {details} is a run of already-translated sentences, may be empty-ish text.
notify.entity_health_single: {name} is the entity kind (translated); {entity_id} is a literal entity id inside quotes; {consequence} is a whole sentence.
notify.invariant_violated: {detail} is a whole translated sentence from the watchdog; this is a safety alert.
notify.promise_p1_cool: 'AC' is the air conditioner. {near} picks 'right at' or 'only {dip} over'.
notify.promise_p1_heat: {near} picks 'right at' or 'only {dip} under'. 'comfort minimum' is the lower comfort setpoint.
notify.promise_p4_changed: 'manual change' = an occupant override still within its grace period.
notify.stall_diag: {mode} and {action} are raw thermostat state codes: leave them unchanged.
notify.stall_message: {direction} picks below/heating (heat) or above/cooling (cool). {diag} is a nested message.
notify.welcome_home_hold: {hold} selects what the restore waits for; keep the phrase grammatical after 'once'.
notify.whf_reason_backstop_stop_fan: Activity Record text. {mode} and {action} are raw thermostat state codes.
notify.whf_reason_backstop_suppress_hvac: Activity Record text. {mode} and {action} are raw thermostat state codes.
notify.whf_stale_sensors: {names} is a list of sensor names or a count phrase; {count} drives has/have and it/them.
notify.whf_stop_failed: {detail} is a nested clause ending without a period; keep the colon structure. Safety alert: short and imperative.
